intro: A Free Lunch is an Alliance errand originating in Lakeshire, where the inn cook Darcy asks an adventurer to take a prepared meal to Guard Parker. Parker patrols the perilous southern road heading toward Duskwood, keeping Lakeshire's approaches clear of hostile gnolls and Blackrock orcs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Can you do me a favor? I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol...he's a big, strong Stormwind guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me.
So if you deliver his lunch for me, then come back here and I'll give you a free lunch! Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to Duskwood.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she? Such a kind heart she has. Well...let's have it!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks, I could really use the meal. Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
